name: 扰乱三角飓风！！
nameJa: おジャマ・デルタハリケーン！！
desc: 自己场上有「扰乱·绿」「扰乱·黄」「扰乱·黑」表侧表示存在的场合才能发动。对方场上存在的卡全部破坏。
faq: If your opponent chains "Ring of Destruction" or "Book of Moon" to "Ojama Delta Hurricane!!", and one of the Ojamas is destroyed or flipped face-down, "Ojama Delta Hurricane!!"'s effect still resolves.
